scope: Fixed audible-event timing observation; no model-template matching or alignment/score replacement.
conclusion: All18 primary audible onset estimates occur22-63ms after frozen MIDI mapping. Final release1dB departures are ~43-48ms after frozenoff. Actual MIDIedge and exactglobalcorrection remain unidentified.

alignment.method: Globally whitened 12-bin STFT chroma; fixed harmonic MIDI chroma; global affine grid/differential evolution, no local warping.
caveats: Approximate chroma onset alignment depends on patch attack.
MIDI file identity is supported by description and global pitch progression; sender settings and channel routing remain unknown.
All source MIDI velocities are127; this does not independently verify hardware velocity processing.

protocol.selection: Fixed patches5,18,88,99; MIDI>=72; onset>=.10s past inferred program boundary; previous same-note MIDI off>=.25s before onset. All rows retained; no audio-based replacement.
protocol.analysis: Arithmetic stereo mid; centered Hann tone demodulation at nominal carrier frequency; windows12/24/48ms. Median before[-.12,-.07]s and after[+.07,+.11]s define amplitude step; crossings10/50/90percent searched[-.08,+.14]s. Primary24ms50percent. No DSP/model render used. No captured/synth correlation or timing-score search.
protocol.failure_rule: Nonpositive step; crossing absent; after/before amplitude contrast<2; nonpersistent crossing. All failures retained.
protocol.release: Final Sine79,87: independent continuous two-slope log-amplitude segmented least squares at possible breakpoints frozenoff±.12s. Fit sample interval frozenoff[-.12,+.15]s. Before and after independent slopes with continuity; only slope change<0 and after slope<0 acceptable. Repeat all three Hann lengths.

descriptive_global_trend.type: Post-observation descriptive Theil-Sen regression of unique audible-onset-group residuals against source MIDI time; no benchmark alignment replacement
descriptive_global_trend.caveat: Formal interval assumes independent exchangeable group errors; patch-dependent output attack and local timing invalidate treating it as physical clock confidence.

posthoc_release_departure_protocol.status: Posthoc sensitivity diagnostic, frozen after reviewing the original one-break traces
posthoc_release_departure_protocol.reason: The original one-break release model spans a steep decay and a flattening tail. Its change point is biased by the later bend and cannot identify note-off.
posthoc_release_departure_protocol.selection: Same final Sine99 MIDI79 and87, no added/removed notes
posthoc_release_departure_protocol.method: Same nominal-tone Hann demodulation and12/24/48ms windows. Fit held-level linear dB trend over frozenoff[-.12,0]s. Find first persistent3ms departure by0.5,1,3,6dB below projected held trend over frozenoff[-.05,+.15]s. These are observed amplitude-departure times, not MIDIoff times, envelope-law fits or alignment changes.

limitations: Existing tour is reused material, not an independent holdout.
Observed tone transitions include sender/interface/output/capture latency and processing.
Raw AR63 constrains attack intent, not every detail of RKS or voice dispatch.
Onset groups clustered in only four short preset intervals; affine slope not independently identified.
Original one-break final release fit is biased by a later flattening tail; it is not MIDIoff detection.
Short Hann windows fail when neighboring pitches leak; those failures remain recorded.
Method checks use abstract steps, not a measured hardware or capture simulator.
